name: Massachusetts Good Neighbor Energy Fund
provider: The Salvation Army (Massachusetts Good Neighbor Energy Fund)
description: Energy bill help for Massachusetts residents who, because of temporary financial difficulty, cannot meet a month's energy expense and are not eligible for state or federal energy assistance. Qualifying households may receive up to $400 per household per heating season. Requests go through The Salvation Army.
contact: Contact your local Salvation Army Corps Community Center; if none is listed nearby, 413 area code: 800-262-1320

requirements.text: Total gross yearly income must be no more than 80% of state median income (2026-2027 guidelines).
Applicant is not eligible for state or federal energy assistance.
Because of temporary financial difficulty, cannot meet a month's energy expense.

unknowns: Whether the bill must be past due or facing shutoff
Whether payment goes directly to the utility or vendor
Nearest Salvation Army location for Amherst (none listed in Amherst/Northampton; Holyoke and Greenfield are listed)
Exact season start/end dates (funds disbursed until end of summer or while funds last)
